rules: Use Manrope for body text and UI elements.
Body text should be Zinc-400 or Zinc-500 for hierarchy.
Use JetBrains Mono for data values, code snippets, or API keys.

layout.spacing_system: Generous (2x standard). Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.
layout.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode B for Dashboards, Mode A for Marketing)
container_rules: Dashboard Widgets: col-span-1 to col-span-3 based on importance.
Marketing Sections: Use asymmetric grid (e.g., 8 col vs 4 col).

cards.style: Flat, 1px border, no shadow by default.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)] rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-3
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-3

inputs.style: bg-input/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md h-11

navigation.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-border/40 z-50
navigation.header: sticky top-0 w-full h-16 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-lg border-b border-border/40 z-40

media.icons: Lucide React (default), Phosphor Icons (for dashboard density)

guidelines: Use staggered entrance for dashboard cards.
Use layoutId for shared element transitions.
Page transitions: fade in + slight slide up.

charts.style: Minimalist, no grid lines (or very subtle), tooltip with glassmorphism.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
